_comment: NeMo Data Designer recipe template for RFT prompt generation. Two-stage question generation (arxiv 2509.25736): raw_question from topic context alone → question_chunks retrieval → user_message grounds raw_question in question-specific chunks. Copy, replace <PLACEHOLDERS>, and adapt prompts for your domain. NOTE: _comment fields are NOT allowed inside column objects — NeMo rejects them. Only this top-level _comment is safe. topic_context expression column re-materializes the seed topic_path so it is guaranteed available in all downstream llm-text Jinja2 contexts (seed columns can disappear from context after drop:true columns process).

columns.name: raw_question
system_prompt
user_message
reference_answer
judge_answerable

scores.name: answerable
scores.description: Whether the question can be answered from the provided context alone, without outside knowledge.

options.0: Context does not contain sufficient information to answer the question.
options.1: Context contains sufficient information to answer the question.

columns.name: judge_groundedness

scores.name: groundedness
scores.description: Whether every claim in the answer is directly supported by the retrieved context.

options.0: Not grounded — answer contains claims absent from or contradicted by context.
options.0.5: Partially grounded — most claims supported but some require outside knowledge.
options.1: Fully grounded — every claim is directly supported by context.

columns.name: judge_specificity

scores.name: specificity
scores.description: Whether the question contains domain-specific terms grounded in the retrieved context.

options.0: Generic — question uses no domain-specific terms found in the context.
options.1: Specific — question uses domain terminology present in the context.
